자동 실행 경로

  • The provided code shows no evidence of .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, setup.py install hooks, PEP 517 build hooks, or install-time automatic execution.
  • planetarypy/cli.py defines a Typer-based CLI. This appears to be normal user-invoked CLI behavior, not malicious execution during installation or interpreter startup.
  • ConfigHandler.__init__() can download a TOML configuration file from a GitHub raw URL when the local config is missing or stale. In context, this appears to be normal project configuration retrieval and is not tied to credential harvesting, stealth loading, or install-time execution.

절취/전송/지속성/측면이동/은닉

  • Credential theft: No evidence of broad discovery or collection of environment variables, .env files, SSH keys, cloud/CI tokens, wallets, kubeconfig files, or similar secrets.

  • Persistence: No evidence of cron jobs, systemd units, launch agents, shell profile modification, reinstall loops, or background backdoor polling.
  • Lateral movement: No evidence involving Kubernetes service-account tokens, Docker socket access, cloud metadata endpoints, CI/CD tokens, or GitHub Actions workflow injection.
  • Obfuscation/loaders: The re.compile findings are consistent with URL/file-name pattern matching. No evidence of eval/exec, base64/zlib/marshal loaders, or obfuscated payloads was found.
  • Process execution: _repo.py uses git clone/pull to fetch definitions from the public pdr-tests repository. This appears to be functional data retrieval, with no evidence of install-time execution or malicious payload execution. The macOS open call in cli.py occurs after a user runs the hibrowse command and appears to be normal CLI behavior.
